newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Sui Chong surges on stake sale talks.
newsitem.headline: Sui Chong surges on stake sale talks.

text.p: Shares of Sui Chong Holdings Ltd surged after the company announced that its parents were in talks to sell control of the company, brokers said.
"Speculation of a high buy out offer price if they (the parents) finalise a deal fueled short term demand," said a sales manager at a local brokerage.
Sui Chong shares were up HK$0.25 or 20.83 percent to HK$1.45 in late morning, after hitting a year high of HK$1.55. Volume was 18.23 million shares worth HK$26.64 million.
The shares had surged 23.71 percent to HK$1.20 on Wednesday morning before trading was suspended.

Sui Chong said on Thursday its majority shareholders Winfoong International Ltd and Hong Fok Corp Ltd were in talks to sell their aggregate 74.5 percent stake in the company, which could result in a change of company control and an obligation for the buyer to make a general offer.
